verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents an end-user surface for viewing or revoking which apps hold access to bank data. The consent mentions (stored account details, verification consent) are about consent capture inside integration flows, not user-facing management or revocation. Console is a merchant-side tool for payments, balances and team access, not an end-user consent portal.

support.subject: As an ops lead, end users can see and revoke what they've shared — a documented consent surface or portal where a user manages which apps hold access to their bank data
